posts.title: Craftsmanship and Couture: SILVER & ELEGANT’s LFW 2026 Journey
posts.summary: From our studio in Borehamwood to the iconic runway at The Waldorf Hilton: A reflection on the creative journey and partnerships that defined our LFW 2026 experience with SILVER & ELEGANT.

sections.body:
### The Light Behind the Runway – LFW 2026 Diaries

London Fashion Week is far more than just a series of runway shows; it is a collective celebration where design, craftsmanship, and creative passion converge. As **SILVER & ELEGANT**, we were honoured to be part of Paul Costelloe’s mesmerising opening show this year, truly feeling the pulse of the runway.![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1UMAhUtqWb3UKpkhCxSRmQVTx90jNs39H&usp=drive_copy)

The intensity of the preparation, the unparalleled energy of the show, and the cherished professional connections that followed… The moment shared with William Costelloe perfectly encapsulated the pride of seeing our design vision resonate on an international stage. Meanwhile, our conversation with stylist Borna Prikaski was the purest form of that creative interaction which fuels the design language of **SILVER & ELEGANT**.

![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1y5WBqma0yt60hCHlvwyTn5aqV1I0Y8dO&usp=drive_copy)

Ultimately, fashion derives its meaning from these very connections. Thank you to everyone who shared in our passion for design throughout this journey. At **SILVER & ELEGANT**, we are continuing to channel the inspiration we gathered from that unforgettable atmosphere into our new collections, and we look forward to sharing our story with you as it unfolds.

![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1sVaVCoAvSFabgUiVPaBUnUM80XRowfwp&usp=drive_copy)

![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1udCXN1GBcWpI8ZYS96DREtNWni_ItJoT&usp=drive_copy)

posts.title: A Curatorial Narrative: Silver & Elegant Featured in KALTBLUT Magazine’s "THE DISH"
posts.summary: Our designs have been curated within KALTBLUT Magazine's latest digital editorial, "THE DISH"—an avant-garde exploration intersecting contemporary jewellery and high-fashion creative direction.

sections.body:
Silver & Elegant is pleased to announce that our designs have been curated within the latest digital editorial, **"THE DISH,"** by KALTBLUT Magazine—a premier platform for avant-garde fashion and independent contemporary art.

This collaboration explores the precise intersection of contemporary jewellery and defiant creative direction. The structural silhouettes and permanent forms of our pieces are recontextualised as wearable narrative objects within a landscape of high-fashion editorial aesthetics and experimental storytelling.

"THE DISH" is now live at KALTBLUT Magazine, brought to life by a visionary creative collective and a distinct curation of independent designers.

- **Creative Team:** Doma Dovgialo, Borna Prikaski, Yassine V.K, Ambra Castelli, Giulia Oldani, Tobia Bartolini, Christina Lomas, Scarlett Leatham, Shyy Sachdev.
- **Featured Brands:** Silver & Elegant, Alice Skewis Jewellery, Capsule Eleven, Vicki Sarge, Annabel B. Jewellery.

posts.title: From Studio to Runway: Paul Costelloe AW26 and Regional Feature

sections.body:
_Borehamwood Times_ covers SILVER & ELEGANT’s trajectory from regional studio practice to the London Fashion Week AW26 runway as official jewellery partner to Paul Costelloe.

  

The profile examines the studio's technical foundation, linking founder Esen Tunalı Sarı’s background in software development to structural jewellery design. By pairing computational design methods with single-artisan physical execution in Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, SILVER & ELEGANT operates outside seasonal fashion cycles to produce permanent sculptural forms — Future Heirlooms engineered for structural longevity.

  

The London-based studio continues to develop physical editions and computational concepts from its Hertfordshire base.

posts.title: Sculptural Forms in Focus: Silver & Elegant Featured in Flanelle Magazine
posts.summary: Silver & Elegant designs are curated within KALTBLUT Magazine's latest digital editorial, "THE DISH"—an avant-garde exploration intersecting contemporary jewellery and high-fashion creative direction.

sections.body:
Silver & Elegant Co. is delighted to announce that our handcrafted, structural jewellery designs have been curated within the latest contemporary fashion editorial for **Flanelle Magazine**—a distinct platform dedicated to independent style, fine art, and raw visual storytelling.

![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1lEUVM91a3hsfH8XfnVbckKyDwNWLNDMH&usp=drive_copy)

In this evocative collaboration, the monumental silhouettes and precise geometry of our pieces are recontextualised alongside sharp avant-garde hair design, dramatic contrast, and meticulous styling architecture. By aligning our ethos of permanence and "Future Heirlooms" with a highly visioned creative collective, our designs emerge as captivating narrative objects that challenge conventional elegance.

![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1wRWITAIE-5fP7YMFG9fAQHYebv3mB1in&usp=drive_copy)

We extend our gratitude to the exceptional creative team behind this Flanelle Magazine feature:

- **Photography:** Izabela Wojnarowska
- **Styling:** Tia Oguri
- **Makeup & Hair:** Karoliina Villem
- **Hair:** Anne Veck
- **Retouching:** Daria Sheyanova
- **Model:** Yitian Lu

![](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1cWljvPoWE-RbZ53hSRpTaYK5x0YeMe1k&usp=drive_copy)
